description:
Dive into Scripture as challenging questions are answered with clarity and insight. This episode explores how we know Saturday is the true seventh-day Sabbath, the identity of the Triune God, and Bible translation accuracy. Viewers will also gain understanding of why some Christians avoid certain foods, whether the Antichrist requires a literal Third Temple, and the relationship between Michael the Archangel and Jesus. Additional topics include the biblical perspective on the Eastern Question and how dietary laws and Sabbath observance align with Paul’s teachings.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org


1. Genesis 1:14 (AMP) states: "Then God said, “Let there be light-bearers (sun, moon, stars) in the expanse of the heavens to separate the day from the night, and let them be useful for signs (tokens) [of God’s provident care], and for marking seasons, days, and years;" So it is proven that God's calendar is based on a lunar solar calendar and the sabbath is set each month by the new moon. When incorporated into the Georgian calendar, the sabbath day will change each month. Can you elaborate on this and explain how the true 7th day sabbath is correct using Saturday on the pagan calendar? How do we know Saturday is the true seventh-day Sabbath?

2. What are the triune gods? And what is the significance of being introduced in the Adventist church? 

3. I am using the New King James Bible to study with. We were studying Daniel 3 when the pastor pointed out that the word sackbut was left out of the NKJV Version. He felt that the word sackbut was a misinterpretation in the KJV, so they left it out of the NKJV. Is this correct? What Bible version is the most accurate to the original manuscripts? 

4. In the book of Acts, God told Peter not to call anything unclean that He had created, and Jesus said that what goes into a person does not defile them, but what comes out does. In light of this, why do some Christians still refrain from eating pork? 

5. I told a friend that the papacy is the Antichrist, and she asked about the Bible’s statement that the Antichrist will sit in the temple of God. How does that relate to the idea of a future Third Temple, and will such a temple actually be rebuilt? Does the Antichrist require a literal Third Temple?

6. I recently heard that some say Michael the Archangel and Jesus are the same person. If they are the same, how can it be the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit Trinity? Can you help me understand this, please? Does the Bible teach that Michael the Archangel is Jesus?

7. What is the Eastern Question, and is it biblical?

8. How do we reconcile dietary laws and Sabbath-keeping with Paul’s writings in 1 Timothy 4:1–5, Galatians 4:10, and Colossians 2:16?
